name: llama-offload
what_it_does: Hands a large batch of similar, mechanical text jobs to a free AI model running on your own computer, instead of doing each one in the conversation.
what_you_say: normalize all the names in this spreadsheet against the roster
what_you_get: A sample you approve first, then a results file and counts of what was processed and what it could not decide.
on_your_computer: Writes a marker file under `~/.claude/state` and writes results to a file, and sends each item to an Ollama program already running on your own computer. It shows you a sample and waits for your approval before processing the whole batch.

name: model-effort-advisor
what_it_does: Recommends which Claude model and how much thinking to use for a task, and whether to hand parts of it to separate helpers.
what_you_say: which model should I use for this?
what_you_get: A short recommendation naming the model, the effort level, and whether to split the work, with the reasons.

name: supahcode-review
what_it_does: Judges whether the task you have been discussing is large enough to be worth running as a big multi-step automated workflow, and says no when it is not.
what_you_get: A score against six criteria, a yes or no verdict, a cost estimate, and on a yes, text you can paste into Claude Code yourself.

name: transcript-scanner
what_it_does: Searches your past Claude Code conversations, which are stored on your computer, for specific facts and reports them with the exact file and line.
what_you_say: find every time I corrected you about deploys last month
what_you_get: A list of findings, each quoted with the file and line it came from, and a plain statement where nothing was found.
on_your_computer: Reads small pieces of your own session log files under `~/.claude/projects`. It writes nothing, changes nothing and goes online for nothing.
